name: My Wishes shows 1 of 4 (the seeded My Story answer) before any wish
answer one wish in the UI: counter becomes 2 of 4 in both sections
answer one My Story question in the workspace: 3 of 4 shared
a fourth answer (wish, via the API like another tab): 4 of 4; a fifth via the API is 409 TRIAL_LIMIT
at the cap: an unanswered wish shows Pro and opens the dialog (View plans / Close); Escape closes and focus returns
Close button closes the dialog and returns focus to the Pro control
My Story at the cap: the current new question shows Pro instead of the answer box; the memory picker shows Pro
an existing answer stays editable at the cap (edit + save; count stays 4)
deleting an answer frees a slot: 3 of 4, and the locked wish opens as a form
stale-limit refusal: the open form keeps the typed text and shows the message with View plans
clearing the words of a linked answer in the UI frees a slot; its linked memory stays
plan loading: a new answer shows "Checking your plan…" and no answer box
plan unreadable: retry state, then Check plan again opens the form
paid account: no trial counter, no Pro, new questions open
